items.title: Workflow lab: Turning context into a plan with Specs and the Figma agent
items.excerpt: Figma walks through a workflow in which Specs and the Figma agent hold the product context (requirements, decisions, constraints) next to the design, so the agent can turn it into an implementation plan and hand it to code.

items.title: Stop Making AI Agents Click Through Your Web App
items.excerpt: CopilotKit argues that agents clicking through UIs built for people waste tokens, and shows how WebMCP plus CopilotKit let a web app expose its functions to an agent directly, a shift in how app interfaces are designed for agent users.

items.title: Lovable keeps working while you answer its questions
items.excerpt: Lovable can now ask a question and keep building while the user decides: it builds what doesn't depend on the answer, picks an option for the rest and reworks it if the user chooses differently, but waits before hard-to-undo steps like deleting data. (Changelog entry, date-only.)

items.title: 에이바 스튜디오, 인기 출시 영상의 컷을 내 제품 화면으로
items.excerpt: Ava Studio released 'Launch Videos' (Nov 17), which analyses the shot order, cut lengths and camera moves of launch videos that went viral on X and rebuilds them with the user's own product screens; it runs as a plugin inside Claude Code and Codex.

items.title: The judge used to be the user
items.excerpt: UX Collective essay (Wira Indra Kusuma): AI collapsed the slow middle of building models, and the people who once defined what 'correct' meant, users and researchers, went with it. (Essay; Medium blocks fetch, excerpt from RSS.)

items.title: This movie poster is one big AI slop Easter egg hunt
items.excerpt: The poster for 'Artificial', the Sam Altman/OpenAI film, is deliberately packed with AI-slop tells for viewers to spot; Fast Company reports it was made by humans as a marketing play. Check movies for cross-section dup.

items.title: Claude has a new mobile design, too.
items.excerpt: Anthropic is rolling out a refreshed Claude mobile app with a bottom tab bar for chat, Projects, Code and Artifacts (iOS 26+ first), a day after OpenAI previewed a similar tab-bar redesign of ChatGPT; AI assistants are converging on the same app layout.

items.title: OpenAI is testing a new design for mobile ChatGPT.
items.excerpt: ChatGPT's mobile redesign adds a bottom tab bar with Home and a dedicated tab for the user's Dot agent, plus pinnable spots for Codex or Images; Pro users with Dots see it first. OpenAI help center documents the new Home/Explore layout.

items.title: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer
items.excerpt: Google brings computer use to the Gemini Mac app for AI Plus, Pro and Ultra users: an agent that operates desktop apps, local files and websites in an isolated background window, with users choosing which apps it can access.

items.title: Building a Software Factory
items.excerpt: Runway describes moving from AI-assisted engineers to an AI-run delivery line 'one station at a time', with agents handling stages of its software pipeline. (Vendor engineering post, date-only; a third-party summary cites approval waits cut to five minutes, not verified in body.)

items.title: Etsy says it will not use sellers' content to train AI after they revolt over policy changes
items.excerpt: After artists and makers left Etsy over a new AI-training clause in its terms of use, Etsy clarified it will not use sellers' content to train AI that can copy their work. Follow-up to the 11-18 Creative Bloq exodus story.

items.title: Student Creators Harness AI In Storytelling
items.excerpt: Autodesk Research describes a SCAD design challenge in which students used AI tools in animation and storytelling projects, and what the research team learned about how creators fold AI into their process.

items.title: Google's latest AI model is faster, cheaper and smarter than its flagship predecessor from just weeks ago
items.excerpt: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth model in seven weeks: nearly 2x faster than Gemini 4 Carbon, ahead on most benchmarks and cheaper; rolling out in Gemini, Antigravity and the API (also live in Cursor).

items.title: Gemini can now be your go-to source for making GIFs
items.excerpt: Google says the Gemini app can now generate GIFs from a prompt, using its latest video-generation model (Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash). (Off-list outlet; no on-list render source covered it.)

items.title: XJet launches AI-driven Atelier platform for bespoke jewelry
items.excerpt: XJet Atelier lets users describe a charm in a few words or upload a photo; AI tools generate and refine the design, show a 360-degree preview and send it to XJet's metal 3D printers in stainless steel or sterling silver. (Page shows byline date Nov 19; time from Google News.)

items.title: Comsol Conference 2026 highlights: Simulation and AI
items.excerpt: Engineering.com's Comsol Conference report covers the latest COMSOL Multiphysics release and how engineers are using AI with simulation, including assistant and surrogate-model workflows.

items.title: AI News: This Is The Make or Break Week!!
items.excerpt: Matt Wolfe's weekly AI roundup: hands-on tests of GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol and Gemini 4 Neon, Microsoft's latest AI releases, Gemini Notebook's website builder, HeyGen Avatar 6 and more.
